sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.7 "EXTI rising trigger selection register 2 (EXTI_RTSR2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 456.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x020
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Contains only register bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 RT39: Rising trigger event configuration bit of configurable event input 39(1)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is disabled, RT39 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is enabled, RT39 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit x is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: Rising trigger disabled (for event and interrupt) for input line
1: Rising trigger enabled (for event and interrupt) for input line
Bits 6:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 RT36: Rising trigger event configuration bit of configurable event input 36(1)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is disabled, RT36 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is enabled, RT36 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit x is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: Rising trigger disabled (for event and interrupt) for input line
1: Rising trigger enabled (for event and interrupt) for input line
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 2 RT34: Rising trigger event configuration bit of configurable event input 34(1)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is disabled, RT34 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is enabled, RT34 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit x is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: Rising trigger disabled (for event and interrupt) for input line
1: Rising trigger enabled (for event and interrupt) for input line
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
1. The configurable event inputs are edge triggered, no glitch must be generated on these inputs.
If a rising edge on the configurable event input occurs during writing of the register, the associated pending bit is not set.
Rising and falling edge triggers can be set for the same configurable event input. In this case, both edges generate a
trigger.
